title: Reassessing Evaluation Practices in Visual Question Answering: A Case Study on Out-of-Distribution Generalization

bias_targets.target: Dataset bias (Language and Answer Prior Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using zero-shot cross-dataset settings and the VQA-CP benchmark (which has explicitly different train/test answer distributions) to measure performance drops caused by overfitting to training answer priors and question formats, rather than learning true visual grounding.
